content:
OpenAI is working on a feature that would allow you to export stickers generated by ChatGPT directly to WhatsApp. Here are the details.

The feature is still under development.

No matter where you are or how old you are, there's a good chance you can't go a whole day — or even a few hours — without sending or receiving a WhatsApp sticker.

For those unfamiliar, stickers on messaging apps are small images that users send in chat, similar to emojis or GIFs. Stickers are usually organised into sticker packs, and can include custom illustrations or meme-style images with text.

WhatsApp already has a built-in AI sticker generator powered by Meta AI, allowing users to create images from text prompts. Now, according to Android Authority, OpenAI appears to be working on bringing a similar sticker generation feature to ChatGPT.

According to the site, the latest version of the ChatGPT Android app contains strings related to creating, exporting and downloading stickers, as follows:

ChatGPT stickers Add to chat app Add to WhatsApp WhatsApp (minimum 3) Unable to add sticker to WhatsApp Download sticker

Android Authority added that the minimum three requirement comes from WhatsApp, not OpenAI.

Since the feature was discovered by tearing down the APK file, it's not yet clear when it will officially launch — or even if it will be released publicly.
